_meta.source: Shogun Showdown wiki, Consumables page (shogunshowdown.wiki.gg), fetched 2026-10-28, CC BY-SA 4.0. Looks are from the bot's frames.

fields.effect: machine-readable effect used by the bot and the simulator
fields.screen_id: label perception gives the item in the consumable column (perceive.read_consumables)
fields.look: how the item looks in the consumable column, with the source of that read

rules.max_held_source: [wiki] the Big Pockets skill raises it
rules.full_inventory: a collected consumable turns into 1 coin [wiki]
rules.obtained: dropped by slain enemies, sold in shops; left-over drops are collected at the end of combat [wiki]

consumables.name: Edamame Brew
consumables.look: bottle with a cork, green liquid [bot]

consumables.name: Kami Brew
consumables.look: bottle with a cork, blue liquid [bot]
consumables.text: Grants a shield that negates the next attack received.

consumables.name: Cool Up
consumables.look: bottle with a cork, pale grey-white liquid [bot: run 20261028-061420 item_unknown.png]; identified as Cool Up by elimination, the wiki lists exactly three brews [inference]
consumables.text: Recharges all tiles and the hero's special ability.

consumables.name: Mass Curse
consumables.text: Curses every enemy; a cursed enemy takes double damage from the next hit.

consumables.name: Mass Poison
consumables.look: green card with a pale skull [bot]
consumables.text: Poisons every enemy for 3 turns; 1 damage at the end of each turn.

consumables.name: Mass Ice
consumables.look: navy card with a cyan crystal [bot]

consumables.name: Rain of Mirrors
consumables.look: grey card [user]; not yet seen by the bot (the grey card logged as mirror_card in run 20261028-122652 was the Lucky Die [user 2026-10-28])
consumables.text: Turns every enemy and boss around.

consumables.name: Lucky Die
consumables.look: grey-white card with six red pips, a die face [user 2026-10-28] [bot: run 20261028-122652 f0026_CLICK.png, item_mirror_card.png]
consumables.text: In combat: rerolls enemy intentions. Out of combat: rerolls a reward or a shop.
